verses: Yaqeenan eman walon ney falah hasil kerli
Jo apni namaz mein khushoo kertay hain
Jo laghwiyaat say mun mor letay hain
Jo zakat ada kerney walay hain
Jo apni sharamghaon ki hifazat kerney walay hain
Ba-juz apni biwiyon aur milkiyat ki londiyon kay yaqeenan yeh matiyon mein say nahi hain
Jo uss kay siwa kuch aur chahayen o hi hadd say tajawuz ker janey walay hain
Jo apni amanaton aur waday ki hifazat kerney walay hain
Jo apni namazon ki nigehbani kertay hain
Yehi waris hain
Jo firdous kay waris hun gay jahan woh hamesha rahen gay
Yaqeenan hum ney insan ko mitti kay johar say peda kiya
Phir ussay nutfay bana ker mehfooz jagah mein qarar dey diya

Phir nutfay ko hum ney jama hua khoon bana diya, phir uss khoon kay lothray ko gosht ka tukra kerdiya. Phir gosht kay tukray ko hadiyan bana den, phir haddiyon ko hum ney gosht pehna diya, phir doosri banawat mein uss ko peda kerdiya. Barkaton wala hai woh Allah jo sab say behtareen peda kerney wala hai
Uss kay baad phir tum sab yaqeenan marr janey walay ho
Phir qayamat kay din bula shuba)yeh tum sab uthaye jao gay
Hum ney tumharay upper saat aasman banaye hain aur hum makhlooqaat say ghafil nahi hain
Hum aik sahih andaz say aasman say pani barsatay hain, phir ussay zamin mein thehra detay hain, aur hum uss kay ley janey per yaqeenan qadir hain
Ussi pani kay zariye say hum tumharay liye khujooron aur angooron kay baghaat peda ker detay hain, kay tumharay liye unn mein boht say meway hotay hain unn hi mein say tum khatay bhi ho
Aur woh darakht jo tor si na pahar say nikalta hai jo tel nikalta hai aur khaney walay kay liye salan hai

Tumharay liye chopayon mein bhi bari bhari ibrat hai. Unn kay peton mein say hum tumhen doodh pilatay hain aur bhi boht say nafa tumharay liye unn mein hain unn mein say baaz baaz ko tum khatay bhi ho
Aur unn per aur kashtiyon per tum sawar keraye jatay ho

Yaqeenan hum ney Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ko uss ki qom ki taraf rasool bana ker bheja, uss ney kaha kay aey meri qom kay logo! Allah ki ibadat kero aur uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi, kiya tum (uss say) nahi dartay

Uss ki qom kay kafir sardaron ney saaf keh diya kay yeh to tum jaisa hi insan hai, yeh tum per fazilat aur baraee hasil kerna chahata hai. Agar Allah hi ko manzoor hota to kissi farishtay ko utarta, hum ney to ussay apney aglay baap dadon kay zamaney mein suna hi nahi
Yaqeenan uss shakhs ko junoon hai, pus tum ussay aik waqt muqarrar tak dheel do
Nooh (alaihi as-salam) ney dua ki aey meray rab! unn kay jhutlanay per to meri madad ker

To hum ney unn ki taraf wahee bheji kay to humari aankhon kay samney humari wahee kay mutabiq aik kashti bana. Jab humara hukum aajaye aur tanoor ubal paray to, to her qasam ka aik aik jora uss mein rakh ley aur apney ahl ko bhi, magar unn mein say jin ki babat humari baat pehlay guzar chuki hai. Khabardaar jin logon ney zulm kiya hai unn kay baray mein mujh say kuch kalaam na kerna woh to sab doboye jayen gay
Jab to aur teray sathi kashti per ba-itminaan beth jao to kehna kay sab tareef Allah kay liye hi hai jiss ney humen zalim logon say nijat ata farmaee
Aur kehna kay aey meray rab! mujhay ba-barkat utarna utaar aur to hi behtar hai utarnay walon mein
Yaqeenan uss mein bari bari nishaniyan hain aur hum be-shak aazmaeesh kerney walay hain
Unn kay baad hum ney aur bhi ummat peda ki
Phir unn mein khud unn mein say (hi) rasool bhi bheja kay tum sab Allah ki ibadat kero uss kay siwa tumhara koi mabood nahi, tum kiyon nahi dartay?

Aur sardaraan-e-kufur qom ney jawab diya, jo kufur kertay thay aur aakhirat ki mulaqat ko jhutlatay thay aur hum ney unhen dunyawi zindagi mein khushal ker rakha tha, kay yeh to tum jaisa hi insan hai, tumhari hi khooraq yeh bhi khata hai aur tumharay peenay ka pani hi yeh peeta hai
Agar tum ney apney jaisay hi insan ki tabeydaari ker li hai to be-shak tum sakht khasaray walay ho
Kiya yeh tumhen uss baat ka wada kerta hai kay jab tum mar ker sirf khak aur haddi reh jao gay to tum phir zindah kiye jao gay
Nahi nahi door aur boht door hai woh jiss ka tum wada diye jatay ho
(zindagi) to sirf duniya ki zindagi hai hum martay jeetay rehtay hain aur yeh nahi kay hum phir uthaye jayen gay
Yeh to bus aisa shakhs hai jiss ney Allah per jhoot (bohtan) bandh liya hai, hum to uss per eman laney walay nahi hain
Nabi ney dua ki kay perwerdigar! unn kay jhutlanay per to meri madad ker
Jawab mila kay yeh to boht hi jald apney kiye per pachtaney lagen gay
Bil-aakhir adal kay taqazay kay mutabiq cheekh ney pakar liya aur hum ney unhen kora karkat ker dala, pus zalimon kay liye doori ho
Unn kay baad hum ney aur bhi boht si ummaten peda kin
Na to koi ummat apney waqt muqarrara say aagay barhi aur na peechay rahi

Phir hum ney lagataar rasool bhejay, jab jab uss ummat kay pass uss ka rasool aaya uss ney jhutlaya, pus hum ney aik doosray kay peechay laga diya aur unhen afsana bana diya. Unn logon ko doori hai jo eman qabool nahi kertay
Phir hum ney Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko aur unn kay bhai Haroon (alaihi as-salam) ko apni aayaton aur khulli daleel kay sath bheja
Firaun aur uss kay lashkaron ki taraf, pus unhon ney takabbur kiya aur thay hi woh sirkash log
Kehney lagay kay kiya hum apney jaisay do shakhson per eman layen? Halankay khud unn ki qom (bhi) humaray ma-tehat hai
Pus unhon ney unn dono ko jhutlaya aakhir woh bhi halak shuda logon mein mill gaye
Hum ney to Musa (alaihi as-salam) ko kitab (bhi) di kay log raah raast per aajayen
Hum ney ibn Maryam aur uss ki walida ko aik nishani banaya aur unn dono ko buland saaf qarar wali aur jari pani wali jagah mein panah di
Aey payghumbaron! halal cheezen khao aur nek amal kero tum jo kuch ker rahey ho uss say mein bakhoobi waqif hun
Yaqeenan tumhara yeh deen aik hi deen hai aur mein hi tum sab ka rab hun, pus tum mujh say dartay raho
Phir unhon ney khud (hi) apney amar (deen) kay aapas mein tukray tukray ker liye, her giroh jo kuch uss kay pass hai ussi per itra raha hai
Pus aap (bhi) unhen unn ki ghaflat mein hi kuch muddat para rehney den
Kiya yeh (yun) samajh bethay hain? Kay hum jo bhi unn kay maal o aulad barha rahey hain
Woh unn kay liye bhalaiyon mein jaldi ker rahey hain (nahi nahi) balkay)yeh yeh samajhtay hi nahi
Yaqeenan jo log apney rab ki haibat say dartay hain
Aur jo apney rab ki aayaton per eman rakhtay hain
Aur jo apney rab kay sath kissi ko shareek nahi kertay
Aur jo log detay hain jo kuch detay hain aur unn kay dil kapkapatay hain kay woh apney rab ki taraf lotney walay hain
Yehi hain jo jaldi jaldi bhalaiyan hasil ker rahey hain aur yehi hain jo unn ki taraf dor janey walay hain
Hum kissi nafs ko uss ki taqat say ziyadah takleef nahi detay, aur humaray pass aisi kitab hai jo haq kay sath bolti hai, unn kay upper kuch zulm na kiya jaye ga
Balkay)yeh unn kay dil uss taraf say ghaflat mein hain aur unn kay liye uss kay siwa bhi boht say aemaal hain jinhen woh kerney walay hain
Yahan tak kay jab hum ney unn kay aasoodah haal logon ko azab mein pakar liya to woh bilbilaney lagay
Aaj mat bilbilao yaqeenan tum humaray muqabla per madad na kiye jao gay.
Meri aayaten to tumharay samney parhi jati thin phir bhi tum apni aeriyon kay bal ultay bhagtay thay
Akartay eenthtay afsana goee kertay ussay chor detay thay
Kiya unhon ney uss baat mein ghor ghor-o-fiker hi nahi kiya? Balkay)yeh unn kay pass woh aaya jo unn kay aglay baap dadon kay pass nahi aaya tha?
Ya unhon ney apney payghumbar ko pehchana nahi kay uss kay munkir ho rahey hain?
Ya yeh kehtay hain kay ussay junoon hai? Balkay)yeh woh to unn kay pass haq laya hai. Haan unn mein aksar haq say chirney walay hain

Agar haq hi unn ki khuwaishon ka pairo hojaye to zamin o aasman aur unn kay darmiyan ki her cheez darhum barhum ho jaye. Haq to yeh hai kay hum ney unhen unn ki naseehat phoncha di hai lekin woh apni naseehat say mun morney walay hain
Kiya aap unn say koi ujrat chahatay hain? Yaad rakhiye kay aap kay rab ki ujrat boht hi behtar hai aur woh sab say behtar rozi rasan hai
Yaqeenan aap to unhen raah raast ki taraf bula rahey hain
Be-shak jo log aakhirat per yaqeen nahi rakhtay woh seedhay raastay say murr janey walay hain
Aur agar hum unn per reham farmaeen aur unn ki takleefen door ker den to yeh to apni apni sirkashi mein jamm ker aur behakney lagen
Aur hum ney unhen azab mein bhi pakra tahum yeh log na to apney perwerdigar kay samney jhukay aur na hi aajzi ikhtiyar ki
Yahan tak kay jab hum ney unn per sakht azab ka darwaza khol diya to ussi waqt foran mayyus hogaye
Woh Allah hai jiss ney tumharay liye kaan aur aankhen aur dil peda kiye, magar tum boht (hi) kum shukar kertay ho
Aur o hi hai jiss ney tumhen peda kerkay zamin mein phela diya aur ussi ki taraf tum jama kiye jao gay
Aur yeh o hi hai jo jilata aur maarta hai aur raat din kay radd-o-badal ka mukhtar bhi o hi hai. Kiya tum ko samajh bojh nahi?
Balkay)yeh unn logon ney bhi wesi hi baat kahi jo aglay kehtay chalay aaye
Kay kiya jab hum marr ker mitti aur haddi hojayen gay kiya phir bhi hum zaroor uthaye jayen gay?
Hum say aur humaray baap dadon say pehlay hi yeh wada hota chala aaya hai kuch nahi yeh to sirf aglay logon kay afsaney hain
Poochiye to sahi kay zamin aur uss ki kul cheezen kiss ki hain? Batlao agar jantay ho?
Foran jawab den gay kay Allah ki, keh dijiye kay phir tum naseehat kiyon nahi hasil kertay
Daryaft kijiye kay saton aasman ka aur boht ba-azmat arsh ka rab kaun hai?
Woh log jawab den gay kay Allah hi hai. Keh dijiye kay phir tum kiyon nahi dartay?
Poochiye kay tamam cheezon ka ikhtiyar kiss kay hath mein hai? Jo panah deta hai aur jiss kay muqablay mein koi panah nahi diya jata, agar tum jantay ho to batla do?
Yehi jawab den gay kay Allah hi hai, keh dijiye phir tum kidhar say jadoo ker diye jatay ho?
Haq yeh hai kay hum ney unhen haq phoncha diya hai aur yeh be-shak jhootay hain

Na to Allah ney kissi ko beta banaya aur na uss kay sath aur koi mabood hai, werna her mabood apni makhlooq ko liye liye phirta aur her aik doosray per charh dorta. Jo osaaf yeh batlatay hain unn say Allah pak (aur bey-niaz) hai
Woh ghaeeb hazir ka jannay wala hai aur jo shirk yeh kertay hain uss say bala-tar hai
Aap dua keren kay aey meray perwerdigar! agar to mujhay woh dikhaye jiss ka wada unhen diya jaa raha hai
To aey rab! to mujhay unn zalimon kay giroh mein na kerna
Hum jo kuch waday unhen dey rahey hain sab aap ko dikha denay per yaqeenan qadir hain
Buraee ko uss tareeqay say door keren jo sirasir bhalaee wala ho, jo kuch yeh biyan kertay hain hum bakhoobi waqif hain
Aur dua keren kay aey meray perwerdigar! mein shetanon kay waswason say teri panah chahata hun
Aur aey rab! mein teri panah chahata hun kay woh meray pass aajayen
Yahan tak kay jab unn mein kissi ko maut aaney lagti hai to kehta hai aey meray perwerdigar! mujhay wapis lota dey

Kay apni chori hui duniya mein jaa ker nek aemaal ker loon, hergiz aisa nahi hoga, yeh to sirf aik qol hai jiss ka yeh qaeel hai, unn kay pus pusht to aik hijab hai, unn kay doobara ji uthney kay din tak
Pus jab kay soor phoonk diya jaye ga uss din na to aapas kay rishtay daar hi rahen gay, na aapas ki pooch gooch
Jin ki tarazoo ka palla bhari hogaya woh to nijat walay hogaye
Aur jin kay tarazoo ka palla halka hogaya yeh hain woh jinhon ney apna nuksan aap ker liya jo hamesha kay liye jahannum o asal huye
Unn kay chehron ko aag jhulasti rahey gi aur woh o haan bad-shakal banay huye hun gay
Kiya meri aayaten tumharay samney tilawat nahi ki jati thin? Phir bhi tum unhen jhutlatay thay
Kahen gay kay aey perwerdigar! humari bad-bakhti hum per ghalib aagaee (waqaee) hum thay hi gumrah
Aey humaray perwerdigar! humen yahan say nijat dey agar abb bhi hum aisa hi keren to be-shak hum zalim hain
Allah Taalaa farmaye ga phitkaray huye yahin paray raho aur mujh say kalaam na kero
Meray bandon ki aik jamat thi jo barabar yehi kehti rahi kay aey humaray perwerdigar! hum eman chukay hain to humen bakhsh aur hum per reham farma to sab meharbano say ziyadah meharban hai
(lekin) tum unhen mazaq mein hi uratay rahey yahan tak kay (uss mashghalay ney) tum ko meri yaad (bhi) bhala di aur tum unn say mazaq hi kertay rahey
Mein ney aaj unhen unn kay uss sabar ka badla dey diya hai kay woh khatir khuwah apni murad ko phonch chukay hain
Allah Taalaa daryaft farmaye ga kay tum zamin mein ba-aetbaar barson ki ginti kay kiss qadar rahey?
Woh kahen gay aik din ya aik din say bhi kum, ginti ginnay walon say bhi pooch lijiye
Allah Taalaa farmaye ga fi fil-waqey tum o haan boht hi kum rahey ho aey kaash! tum ussay pehlay hi say jaan letay?
Kiya tum yeh guman kiye huye ho kay hum ney tumhen yun hi beykaar peda kiya hai aur yeh kay tum humari taraf lotaye hi na jao gay
Allah Taalaa sacha badshah hai woh bari bulandi wala hai. Uss kay siwa koi mabood nahi, o hi buzurg arsh ka malik hai
Jo shakhs Allah kay sath kissi doosray mabood ko pukaray jiss ki koi daleel uss kay pass nahi, pus uss ka hisab to uss kay rab kay upper hi hai. Be-shak kafir log nijat say mehroom hain
Aur kaho kay aey meray rab! to bakhsh aur reham ker aur to sab meharbano say behtar meharbani kerney wala hai
